state:
**Goal `html-later` — Stage 2 is on disk and Stage 3 has its first piece.** ADR 0266 decides the goal. `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs` holds the slots and the one assembly pass. `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs`'s `head_open` makes head members throw `LogicError` inside a slot, and `crates/nvs-types/src/response.rs`'s `reject_head_change_in_later` makes the same calls `E0842` where a closure is written in a `later` call's arguments.

**`#[Core\Route(…, slotted: true)]` compiles and is carried:** `nvs_types::routes::Route::slotted` (roster row `SLOTTED`, folded by `folded_bool`), the attribute card in `crates/nvs-types/src/derive.rs`, `nvs_runtime::routes::Route::with_slotted`/`slotted()`, and the CLI's table build sets it (`crates/nvs-cli/src/main.rs`, beside `without_csrf`). `rule:routing/route-attribute` names the field. Nothing reads `Route::slotted()` at the door yet. The two nvs-types tests `the_route_attribute_takes_slotted` and `slotted_is_carried_to_the_route_table` are green.

`rule:core-classes/html-later` stays `designed` until the slotted half runs. Flip it when Stage 3 lands.

**Known gap, in `later.rs`'s module doc:** slots run when the frame returns, concurrently with each other but not with the main script, and a `later` inside a `Core\Task::all` child is never assembled.

items.text: **`Core\Response::slotted()`** as the runtime switch: a registry row beside `setStatus`, a request-level flag the matched route's `slotted()` also sets, and `slotted_after_the_main_script_ended_throws` (`rule:core-classes/html-later`'s table) — `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs:1`, `crates/nvs-runtime/src/routes.rs:378`.

**The slotted assembly**: on a slotted route the shell goes out when the main script ends with placeholders in place, then each fill as a `<template for>` with the trigger, the polyfill sent once, `</body></html>` held back, no `Content-Length`, `X-Accel-Buffering: no` (`rule:core-classes/html-later`) — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs:1`, `crates/nvs-server/src/serve.rs:1`.

**The polyfill and trigger files with their CSP hashes**, 1 KB and 120-bytes-per-slot limits, and `tools/nv/test/html-later-polyfill.test.ts` under Playwright (`rule:core-classes/html-later`) — `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs:1`.

backlog: The CI `browser` lane in `tools/nv/cmd/ci-changes.ts` and `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (`rule:testing/ci-lanes`), paths `crates/nvs-server/src/slotted/`.

`bun nv proofs --gate` with `later` and slotted routes in the roster (Stage 5).
